title: A Finitely Generated Module Representation of the Bickley-Naylor Functions
summary: We present a novel and non-standard derivation of the Bickley-Naylor functions $Ki_n, n\in\mathbb{N}_0.$ A $3\times 3$ system of equations is developed, the solution of which yields new explicit expressions for the Bickley-Naylor functions $Ki_2$, $Ki_3$, and $Ki_4$. Using a recurrence relation, expressions follow for any other order of Bickley-Naylor functions. We then characterize the infinite set of $Ki_n, n\in\mathbb{N}_0$ as a four-dimensional span of modified Bessel and Struve functions over the ring of real polynomials, thus providing a new computational and modeling tool for studying…
